resources.string: Odisej watches only Instagram. To recognize the Reels screen it reads view IDs and class names — never text, messages or captions. It has no internet permission, so nothing can leave your phone. It stores nothing about your screen.
Blocks Instagram Reels. DMs, feed and stories keep working.
Odisej is watching Instagram for the Reels screen.
Turn on Odisej in Accessibility settings.

On Android 13 and newer, apps installed outside the Play Store can't turn on accessibility services right away ("restricted settings").

1. Try to turn on Odisej once and close the warning.
2. Open App info → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings.
3. Turn on Odisej again.

• No internet permission — nothing can leave your phone.
• Watches only Instagram.
• Reads only view IDs and class names, never text or messages.
• Stores nothing about your screen.
